mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates robust labor market conditions, which historically correlate with rising corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over a 5-day horizon.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of months with PAYEMS growth exceeding 100k, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 9.0%, it signals a deteriorating labor market, which typically precedes reduced consumer spending and corporate profit growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of months when UNRATE > 9.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and low inflation (CPIAUCSL below 2.5%) indicates an accommodative monetary policy environment, which compresses equity discount rates and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines and CPIAUCSL < 2.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (defined by housing starts (HOUST) above 650 thousand units), the S&P 500 tends to experience negative forward returns due to overvaluation and impending economic slowdown.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of months when HOUST > 650, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in real GDP (GDPC1) reflects strong economic growth, which typically supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over a 60-day horizon.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of quarters with GDPC1 growth exceeding 1.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 90, it signals a contraction in manufacturing and industrial output, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days due to reduced corporate activity.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of months when INDPRO < 90, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent rise in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand and economic momentum, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days through improved corporate revenue outlooks.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS rise, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL above 3.0%), the Federal Reserve is likely to implement monetary tightening, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of months when CPIAUCSL > 3.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.
